mentions.name: socialproof.dev
mentions.description: This tool automates collecting social proof and customer testimonials: users share a link, customers fill in a structured form, and submissions can be approved with one click and embedded.
mentions.problem: Collecting customer testimonials sounds simple ("just ask them to write a review") but has terrible follow-through in practice.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on socialproof.dev which automates that step — shareable link, structured form, one-click approve and embed.

evidence.value: I'm working on socialproof.dev which automates that step — shareable link, structured form, one-click approve and embed.
